The function `find_max` initializes a variable `max_num` to negative infinity, ensuring that any number in the input list will be greater than this initial value. It then iterates through each number in the list, updating `max_num` whenever a larger number is found. Finally, it returns the largest number. When executed with the list `[17, 23, 5, 1, 88]`, the function correctly identifies 88 as the maximum value and prints it.
